coreMemory.english: n. knowledge gained by doing or seeing things；v. to have something happen to you or feel something
coreMemory.structure: gain experience /ɡeɪn ɪkˈspɪriəns/（积累经验）；have experience in /hæv ɪkˈspɪriəns ɪn/（有……方面的经验）；learning experience /lɝnɪŋ ɪkˈspɪriəns/（学习经历）；from experience /frʌm ɪkˈspɪriəns/（根据经验）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ use experience with the same article in every context → ✅ check the countability of experience in context；❌ translate experience word by word → ✅ learn the complete phrase “gain experience”

commonErrors.wrong: use experience with the same article in every context

commonErrors.rightPhonetic: /tʃɛk ðə countability ʌv ɪkˈspɪriəns ɪn kɑntɛkst/
